name: DSH Handoff Card
taglineZh: 给下一位自己或 Agent，留张接得住的交接卡。
hook: A pocket checkpoint for your next self or next agent.
description: A native DSH command and model tool for explicit per-session handoff notes, with an offline card studio and reviewable export formats.
features: Explicit goal, progress, next steps, blockers and links
Offline studio with JSON, Markdown, SVG and command output
Chinese/English UI and reports; switching preserves current state
Five-checkpoint session history shared by commands and tools
/handoff history and undo; clear removes all revisions
limitations: Notes are supplied claims, not verified progress
Checkpoint memory is lost on restart or plugin reload
DSH may persist command results and tool arguments in its own history
Web studio is not connected to a live DSH session
demoActions: Export a Chinese or English card
